description: This file defines database entities, views, and related data classes for managing app version information within an Android project, including version metadata, permissions, and manifest details.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Entity representing a specific version of an app, including metadata, manifest, permissions, and vulnerability info.

classes.name: AppVersion
classes.description: Data class representing an app version with associated metadata and permissions.

classes.name: AppManifest
classes.description: Contains manifest details such as version name, code, SDK requirements, signer, features.

classes.name: HighestVersion
classes.description: Database view for retrieving highest version info per package.

classes.name: VersionedString
classes.description: Entity representing a versioned string such as permissions, with type and name.

classes.name: VersionedStringType
classes.description: Enum distinguishing types of versioned strings, e.g., permissions for SDK 23.

methods.name: PackageVersionV2.toVersion
methods.description: Converts a PackageVersionV2 to a Version entity with additional metadata.

methods.name: ManifestV2.getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permission list as VersionedString entities for a given version.

methods.name: ManifestV2.getPermissionsSdk23
methods.description: Retrieves SDK 23 specific permissions as VersionedString entities.

methods.name: LocalizedTextV2.getBestLocale
methods.description: Selects the best localized text for a given locale list.
